ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the failover trigger, fencing strategy and the split-brain flag are declared; it does not show failover works.
offer: Define the trigger and fencing that keep failover from creating two writers. Redundant resources without split-brain protection are not a safe failover design.

minimal.reason: Define what triggers failover. An undefined trigger means failover is manual or accidental, so state the health condition.

mid.reason: Declare the fencing strategy that stops the old primary writing. Redundancy without fencing risks two writers, so name the mechanism.

maximal.reason: Set allowing split-brain to false. Two writers corrupt data, so require fencing to complete before promotion.
